description:
- **Ultimate USB:** Fix native USB initialization failure after patching 12.5.0 build 1205000 (ARM64 APKS). Skip integrity abort in usbNativeInit so physical OTG storage drives are detected and mounted cleanly. Retain USB permissions, transfer error handling, filesystem operations and confirmation dialogs.

Enable pre-releases in the BadFella Patches source in Morphe Manager, refresh Sources, select the original Ultimate USB APKS and apply Ultimate USB local Pro. Install with your existing Manager signing key.

This changes local entitlement and integrity decisions and does not create a Google Play purchase.
